storyInfo: The Royal Guard decide to purge the treatment center in order to eliminate the spies, but are repelled by Hellagur. The Grand Duchess works with the Sami and successfully summons the Yurodstvo before the Royal Guard, anchoring it in the identity of Anastasia, eldest daughter of the previous tsar. In bewilderment, the Rhodes Island team remembers Kal'tsit.

attributes.content: ...Traitor? What are you talking about?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: An intelligence contact point disguised as an Infected treatment center, payment made in supplies instead of cash...
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: All the threads lead to this place, sticking out like a sore thumb.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: What are you hiding here? Who are you harboring?
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: There's one right here. A ghost from the past. Suspicious.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Is it you? Have you returned with the incomplete duty of the past, only to abandon it again?
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: But you are not even carrying a true sword.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Leave him alone! Shouldn't the Royal Guard's top priority be to find the assassin—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Oh.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Trying to change the topic is not an appropriate tactic, Lieutenant.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Hand over the spy.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: So you have reasons to believe the spy who let the assassin into the palace is hiding here.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Fine. But I don't know who this spy you're looking for is. Give me time, and I'll get to the bottom of it—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: My time is limited, Lieutenant.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: If you are unable to give me the answer I want, I shall carry out my mission in the most expedient manner.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: It will not take too much effort to clear this place.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Clear? Like how the Fourth Army cleared those miners?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You are confounding justice and injustice.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: I'm not questioning your intent. But how can you guarantee that your actions are appropriate, that the source of your information wasn't subject to any misdirection?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: It's not just the vulnerable, the outsiders and Infected whom you scorn and suspect. There are also survivors and witnesses to the Grand Duchess's crimes!
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: You're acting on your own in such an important matter. How can you be sure you're not being deceived into making the wrong decision?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Because we do not.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: We are only weapons, extensions of the tsar's hands.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Weapons do not measure or judge. In the hands of the Royal Guard, cause does not lead to effect, only wordless bloodshed.
Eloysius realizes that she has made a fatal mistake, treating the demonic creation before her as a being of reason and emotion—
As for you...
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Tell me, Lieutenant.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: What exactly are you doubting?
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: The stench of Dominion rapidly fills the space.
It brings fear and spreads despair, as is its natural order—
Only when she sees a figure suddenly appear in the way that she realizes her sheathe is empty.
The one who took her sword was so fast that her eyes could hardly follow. A flash of steel, and the spreading darkness is beaten back
Wha—
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: She hardly felt the flow of Originium Arts. The drawing of the sword alone was enough to repel the Royal Guard briefly.
Even a ceremonial sword with hardly any practical purpose.
It seems recent circumstances have driven even your kind to desperation.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Otherwise, your kind would never have taken direct action in Grypherburg, wasting time on chasing uncertain leads.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: At the very least, it has not happened for decades, not since the Great Rebellion.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: ...You cut open the Dominion. You—
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: The Armies have never truly stood together with the Royal Guard. It seems that their counters against the demonic and eldritch remain effective.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Futile struggle.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Are you any different? It has been a long time since the last Royal Guard was punished for acting without authorization.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: His exile to the Far North was upheld, even though it was demonstrated that the individual in question had merely misjudged the situation out of concert for the tsar's safety.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: As far as I know, he never returned to Grypherburg. Perhaps he still roams the blizzards of Sami, pursued by his erstwhile comrades as a calamity—
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Failure is unacceptable. We are the ones who exiled him, not His Imperial Majesty!
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Suspicion has already formed. Many would be glad to see you further alienated from the tsar. Yet you yourselves are in no position to respond openly.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Though you find yourself out of favor with the tsar, you could not point your swords towards him, and so you have engaged in one atrocity after another... Simonch, Chernobog... and others that have remained unknown.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: What do you think you know—
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Tell me, Blade...
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Do your kind know that you are taking a gamble again?
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: ...The last clown who toyed with words has already been put to the torch.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Do you want to follow in his example?
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: I'm afraid threats don't work on me.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: You said I'm a ghost from the past. But I may not always remain that way, if it becomes necessary—though I would prefer that things did not come to that.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: And I will draw my sword for everyone in this building under the protection of Rhodes Island.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: A thousand times and more, if I have to.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Until those like you are repelled, or until I can no longer stand.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: You abandoned Ursus, yet you claim to protect her people.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade
Emperor's Blade
attributes.content: Hypocrisy, foolishness...

attributes.name: Emperor's Blade
attributes.content: Conceit!
You can deny what I say all you want... but I don't think you'll gamble.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Even if it's betting that you can cleanse this place before I kill you.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: You don't want Ursus to lose another Blade.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: We'll see how long your resolve lasts.
attributes.name: Voice in the Darkness

attributes.content: Lieutenant.
attributes.name: Voice in the Darkness

attributes.content: As terror grows distant, the young Imperial Guard finally rediscovers her voice.
...Go on.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: I will give you time. However...
attributes.name: Voice in the Darkness

attributes.content: Whether to stand with the empire, or continue to associate yourself with her traitors and enemies...
attributes.name: Voice in the Darkness

attributes.content: I want to see the answer the next time we meet.
attributes.name: Voice in the Darkness

attributes.content: Your Imperial Highness, the Messenger has returned, three days earlier than expected.
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: Shall I show her in?
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: Please do.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Elisaveta stands up and pushes the unread report to one side out of habit.
The tea has already cooled, bitter brown sediment gathering at the bottom. She knocks the cup lightly with her finger, but it makes no sound, as though she is knocking on a solid object.
Outside the door, the servant seems to be talking to someone, but the conversation is muffled and indistinct, unlike the clearly intelligible words a moment ago.
She begins walking towards the door.
Applewood continues to burn in the black stone fireplace, but the fire is no longer cracking. Even the fire itself begins to grow dull, blending into the surrounding black.
The darkness flows towards Elisaveta, shrouding the surrounding walls in black.
Ilyusha.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Yes, Your Imperial Highness.
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: If the Messenger has any concerns, she can come back tomorrow.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Bring me another cup of tea. Linden honey and lemon slices... just like old times.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: As you wish.
attributes.name: Voice Outside the Door

attributes.content: The crack on the map that leads to Grypherburg, and the wriggling border lines...
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: What are you here to remind me for?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Evgeny Andrianov Kuznetsov will be judged. His defeat is imminent.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Oh? Perhaps he was too young, if he staked everything upon a game of unknowable odds, and wasted all his chips and margin on waiting.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: But what does this have to do with me?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: You concealed the death of a Royal Guard in your demesne, and assisted the Fourth Army in its attempt to hold Grypherburg hostage under the pretense of eliminating rebellious Infected.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: You participated in the entire process.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Your Messenger has told me all I need to know. I even know how much funding and materiel you provided to Kuznetsov.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: I've heard that such threats are simply a tactic you employ to reinforce your public image, in order to become the stuff of children's nightmares, a sword hanging above the people's heads.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Stalling will do you no good, Elisaveta Konstantinovna.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: You do not call me by my patronymic now, the that shares a house with His Imperial Majesty.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Just because you're one of the tsar's last remaining blood kin does not protect you from being put on trial.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: You may have picked the right side in the Great Rebellion, but that won't protect you forever.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: I never thought so. I protected the young tsar at the time because it was the right thing to do. I did not seek any repayment or benefits.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: I was and still am the Grand Duchess of the Far North, no more, no less. I have never sought anything else for myself.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: The soldiers of the Far North have fought on the same side as you countless times in the war against the demons, but today I see you with my own eyes for the first time.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: The Emperor's Blade... the Royal Guard.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Tell me, how could your kind have died at the hands of those feeble, frail Infected?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Your tea, Highness.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: Three minutes, lemon and linden honey, as you requested.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: Thank you, Ilyusha.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Your service is always impeccable. It reminds me of your sister...
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Elisaveta.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Oh, I'm sorry, where were we? Ah, yes, your colleague who died in my jurisdiction—
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Excuse me. If you were discussing this matter and its aftermath...
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: ...Ilyusha?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: I believe the full responsibility for this matter falls upon me.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: Her Imperial Highness entrusted me with unfettered access to this place. I chose to go over her head and issue the blackout order to local governments ahead of time.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: Ilyusha.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: The tacit approval of the Fourth Army's actions was given during my conversation with their herald.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: And the unanswered letters from Grypherburg were destroyed by these hands.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: Her Imperial Highness knew nothing.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: I said, you don't have to—
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Did you think the tsar would believe your story?
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: I never thought you would stoop so low as to pass off your crimes on a servant, Elisaveta.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: But you are still given the luxury of choice. You can choose to end your own life here and now, or face judgment in Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: There is little time—
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: The slender servant suddenly pulls a short sword.
He points it at the impassive entity before him, then—
The Grand Duchess knew nothing.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: Foolhardy.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Before the darkness consumes him, the servant suddenly turns the sword around and stabs himself in the chest.
I will... prove...
attributes.name: Feeble Voice

attributes.content: Ilyusha...
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Fool. This proves nothing.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: The Grand Duchess's expression does not change in the slightest, only a single trail of tear revealing her emotions.
She walks up to the dead servant and closes his eyes.
You're right. He was a foolish boy.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: He was impatient. I told him there was another way, but he would not wait, even for a moment.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Elisaveta.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Shh...
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: You haven't answered my question.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: But it doesn't matter anymore. I'll answer it for you. What could have killed a Royal Guard so easily, wiping him away like a speck of dust...?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: You knew about the Yurodstvo—
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: 'It is time, shaman.'
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: (Ancient Sami) 'Sovereign of the beyond—'
(Ancient Sami) 'The will torn from the void!'
(Ancient Sami) 'I implore, unbound—'
Elisaveta! You have colluded with the Sami in order to control the Yurodstvo—
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: From the summoning, from the blood, from the cold void, a strange shadow emerges from white into crimson, dominating reality.
A million faces, a million pairs of eyes.
Yurodstvo Gabrielus.
Indeed...
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: A piercing, low-frequency howl echoes in the air, which seems to be some kind of language, one which reality lacks the means to comprehend.
You are truly—
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: (Whispers) Finally... success.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: There is no wind, and the only entrance is shut, but two pitch-black figures suddenly appear by the sides of the white monstrosity.
Seize it.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: As they lunge at the target, the floor beneath its feet collapses, or rather, melts—
The Yurodstvo remains standing, seemingly oblivious to the threat.
Yurodstvo Gabrielus.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Ursus does not need you.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: We do not need you!
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: No—!
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: The entity known as the 'Yurodstvo' begins to blur, splitting into countless overlapping silhouettes.
It murmurs, reaching out towards the only living thing here that is not a demonic creation—
The Grand Duchess.
Seeing the failure of the first attempt, the Royal Guards immediately switch position.
Black swords impale the Yurodstvo's flickering, warping torso. White and red peel off to reveal a deep, transparent circle.
The howling does not cease.
No, no...
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: ...The Yurodstvo is suspected to have anchored its identity as a family member of one of the miners.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: ...Miner's child... family of four. The father and mother were executed in 1096, and the grandmother committed suicide soon after. She is the only one left in the household.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: She was amongst the miners who escaped. It must be her.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: It seems that a traumatic reaction, or desperate pursuit of some kind of emotion, is sufficient to anchor the Yurodstvo in our reality.
attributes.name: Silent Servant

attributes.content: Auntie Elisabeth—Auntie Elisabeth!
Where are my apple trees? Why were they replaced with other trees?
Fedya hasn't come. He spends all day staring blankly at mother's bedroom, or crying by himself. If he finds out that the apple trees are gone—
Oh, my dear Nastya.
attributes.name: Elisaveta

attributes.content: The apple trees have gotten a terrible illness. They had to be replaced with other trees that could survive there...
attributes.name: Elisaveta

attributes.content: The 'rust sickness'? Like mother?
...No, it's not the same. Your mother will get better.
attributes.name: Elisaveta

attributes.content: People don't get 'rust sickness'. It's just a common cold. She'll get better.
attributes.name: Elisaveta

attributes.content: 'Just a common cold'?
...What?
attributes.name: Elisaveta

attributes.content: If it's just a common cold...
Why did she grow so thin and frail? Why did she never wake up?
Who are you—
attributes.name: Elisaveta

attributes.content: What are you saying?
attributes.name: Elisaveta

attributes.content: Perish.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: No.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: No, no, no! I will not permit it!
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: It was Nastya—the poor girl no one cared about!
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: You used her, only to abandon her. This time, I will not allow it—
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Come back, Anastasia! Come back to me, and never leave again!
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Anastasia—
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: (Ancient Sami) 'Fire and blood, my wishes upon ye—'
—Elisaveta! What... what have you done?!
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: This is wrong... we have failed! Retreat! Retreat!
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Are you... Anastasia? Or...
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: 'You look exactly like your mother, down to the scent of bitter almonds.' That is what she wanted to say, but she could not say it.
The taste of blood fills her throat. Elisaveta gazes at the miracle before her, forgetting to even breathe.
Time passes second by second. No one dares be the first to act.
Ursus...
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: ...does not need an unruly Yurodstvo, nor a princess who never existed.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Elisaveta, you have declared war upon all of Ursus.
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: ...Anastasia.
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Shall we help them?
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Help these poor madmen and grant them the blessing of pain, those people who wanted to hurt you, control you, make you disappear!
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Grant them this blessing, until they no longer struggle. Then, they will realize—
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: Auntie...
attributes.name: Anastasia?

attributes.content: I'm here, I'm here, my dear Nastya!
attributes.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth

attributes.content: ...Auntie.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: As you wish.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: She looks up fervently at everything. Yet the smile is concocted, as if there is nothing reflected in her eyes that could make herself happy.
The monster now known as Anastasia raises her hand slowly, pointing behind Elisaveta.
I grant you life.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: And grant you death.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: Gabrielus, your duty—
attributes.name: Emperor's Blade

attributes.content: Accept it.
attributes.name: Anastasia

attributes.content: The Royal Guards show no fear. They do not attempt to dodge or flee, allowing themselves to be consumed by the asymmetric shadow, tearing apart their humanoid forms—
The dripping blackness constantly crushed and reconstructed...
Until it is filled and replaced by something else entirely.
Recompute, Zeroth Order Oil Tank.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Set lifeform entropy to minimum... yeah, forget about the complicated stuff for now. Just simulate ideal conditions.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Data fitting failure.
That doesn't work either...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Zeroth Order Oil Tank, log data...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Attempt 2068...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...Still unsuccessful.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: What do we do, Kal'tsit...?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: You said Rhodes Island would do just fine without you...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: ...You damn liar.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Kal'tsit! Kal'tsit—wait!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: What's up with all those confidential files that you hid? I couldn't understand a word of it.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: So you saw them.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Don't pay too much heed to them. They can be unsealed when the time comes. You have plenty of time to study them.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Don't gloss over it. What's up with you handing me full authority over Rhodes Island?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I want to make this an official request.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: When trouble comes to Rhodes Island, you will be the one whom the Doctor and Amiya count on, not just in your capacity as chief engineer.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Not as engineer? What else can I do?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: You see how much Amiya has grown, and you know how smart the Doctor is. How am I supposed to help—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I have no doubt about Amiya's leadership, the Doctor's decisions, or the skills of the elite operators.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: But these are not enough, if Rhodes Island is to become a safe harbor, a home for many people.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: With everyone carrying a heavy responsibility, Rhodes Island needs someone who can give strength to others.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Vision is a rare gift, but so is being unperturbed by challenges.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: That is your gift, Closure. Nobody does it better than you.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit
Closure
attributes.content: Hm...

attributes.name: Closure
attributes.content: Hey, wait a second, you're just calling me short-sighted, aren't you?
You're trying to dump all the work on me because you think I'm a pushover!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I can't promise I won't develop a temper like yours, if I take on that much work.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Well, if you're not willing to take on the responsibility, I'll have to go with my backup plan—
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Wait a second!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Look, I promise I'll do my best to help the Doctor and Amiya...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: But tell the truth, please—you haven't been yourself ever since you came back from Londinium. We can all tell.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: If you're really tired, go and take a long vacation, but stop talking like you won't be around anymore.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Tell me the truth: What sort of future are you planning for?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I'm not making preparations out of pessimism for the future. I'm just hoping Rhodes Island will be in a position to deal with anything that happens.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Rhodes Island will not stop because of the loss of any one person.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: You're always cold as a robot, but now I wish you really were one. It wouldn't be so hard to bring you back, if you were.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: How am I supposed to put you together from this bunch of data?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I don't know how long I can keep going, if you don't come back, Kal'tsit...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Arrrrgggghhh! My head hurts!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I'm hungry. I should get something to eat...
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Is everyone sleeping? No one sneaking in extra shifts, right?
attributes.name: Closure
Closure
attributes.content: Raidian's door is locked...

attributes.name: Closure
attributes.content: Mon3tr forgot to close hers?

attributes.name: Closure
attributes.content: ...She sure sleeps in an interesting way.
Amiya... Doctor?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: (Nods)
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: You saw something terrible tonight.;Are you afraid you'll have nightmares?

attributes.name: Amiya
attributes.content: Stop treating me like a child, Doctor...

attributes.name: Amiya
attributes.content: Mm, I know you're just joking.
Well... I still have dreams about Dr. Kal'tsit and Theresa... they're not nightmares.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: You're not going to bed yet?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: I'm worried about you.;I'm worried about what's to come.

attributes.content: Oh... I guess it's my turn to comfort you.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It's alright. We can chat if you can't sleep... seems like it's been a long time since we've had time to talk in quiet like this.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: We've been very busy.;You've had a lot on your plate.

attributes.content: I'm not as worried about myself as I'm worried about the other operators.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: We haven't fully recovered from what happened to the ship, and a lot has happened in the meantime... now, we have another dilemma in front of us.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I'm worried that people might not pull through. I want to do more for them, but I don't know how...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: You've done so much already.;They see you as a leader they can trust.
You've given a lot of people strength.

attributes.content: Really? I hope you're not saying this just to make me happy...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But... I want to believe that I'll at least be someone you can rely on.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Doctor... do you think we can trust Chairman Witte?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: I trust him.;I'm not sure.;I don't trust him.

attributes.content: I recall that Chairman Witte was a proponent of peace five years ago.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But he could not stop the tragedy that happened in the Far North mines... a tragedy that may yet repeat itself.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: He's obviously keeping a lot from us.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I understand his position, but the hidden mysteries of Zelgrad remain unsettling.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But you're still confident that we can work with him to mutual benefit.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: The situation in Ursus is complex.
The Zelgrad Sarcophagus is the key.
The research here will have implications beyond Ursus's borders.

attributes.content: I understand that we're dealing with a critical issue.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I keep thinking... how many things like this has Dr. Kal'tsit dealt with before?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: What does she think about, when she faces these decisions?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: It must be very hard.;She must be very strong.

attributes.content: Mm...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I'm trying to shoulder the responsibility, but sometimes I can't help thinking, if only Dr. Kal'tsit were here...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Doctor... actually, I'm beginning to have doubts.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: At Chernobog and Londinium, we had a clear goal, an enemy to overcome... but who is our enemy this time?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: We can't stop the fallout of Originium exhaustion, or the deaths brought about by internal strife. People hate each other for reasons beyond Oripathy and race.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I can't help but feel... it's the land itself that we're fighting.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: Maybe that's what Rhodes Island has always been about.;Idealism means fighting this great land itself.

attributes.content: I brought this up because I ran into... an unusual girl. She's Cautus too, maybe even younger than me.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: She asked whether there was any meaning to what we do, if we know we can't save everyone.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I said yes, but I can't deny... sometimes, it makes me anxious to see that our dream is so far away.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: And it's been getting more frequent...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: We can't allow the meaning of our actions to be defined by a distant outcome.;It's the right thing to believe in our dreams. That's why we do what we do.
Fear of failure is inevitable—;But it's not an excuse for inaction.
I choose to believe in hope.;I believe that Terra has a future.

attributes.content: That's the kind of answer I expect to hear from you.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Just like the stories you used to tell me when I was little. Every story has a different fantasy, but in the end, all of them—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Oh... but you don't remember them, do you...?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: Then it's your turn to tell them to me.

attributes.content: Mm-hm...!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: The night is cold. Amiya cuddles up to you.
I understand. I understand it all.
You love life and believe in hope. It is your nature, the bond that ties us together.
But how could you forget...?

attributes.text: <color=#000000>Hope that can never be realized is nothing more than a lie.</color>
